notes.title: Welcome to 2023! The new game content will soon meet you
notes.content:
hello everyone. I'm "Stone", the game producer. I wish you all a happy and safe 2023.

I have been waiting for a long time on this day. I am very happy to introduce the beloved of our studio, "ENCOUNTER OF ISLAND"


1. We are a multi platform independent game. Support PC, Mac and mobile terminal.

2. As a simulation business game, we try our best to restore the essence of the word "simulation" in terms of resource acquisition and growth. We can cook, fish, cut down trees, brush the ground, farm and raise fish. All our production resources are either native, self cultivated or obtained through trading. For this reason, we have designed a complex trading system similar to "futures".

3. Not only designers, but also players. As a group of hardcore users of farming simulation games, we always feel lonely. We hope that in our games, we can meet our favorite peers, play together, chat together, and even walk into each other's real life. So we will try our best to do a good job in social design. Different from traditional farming games, we want to be a social, warm and dreamy game world.

4. We hope we are a game that is free enough but not difficult. So in island diy, we try our best to increase the degree of design freedom, enrich the style of furniture and house components as much as possible, and reduce the complex design that is useless for DIY as much as possible. All our designs want to restore a carefree and free farming game that farmers like.

Thank you for your expectation and support to us. Come on!
